route: One Mac with three spoof subjects through Live Link Hub and Unreal Editor to headless Isaac Sim on Luna2 over Tailscale
geometry: Each confident bone segment endpoint read back from the USD stage agreed with the evaluated pose within 0.00001 metres.
identity: SHA-256 of the entire evaluated frame, matched by subject, editor session and editor tick.
measurement: Timestamp taken after the Isaac pre-physics callback updates all USD performer curves. Per-subject statistics count each distinct applied evaluation once.
clock: One-way ages use the offset from the lowest recent round-trip clock probe. Asymmetry can bias one-way measurements.
limitations: Synthetic capture timestamps and a temporary physics world with USD skeleton curves. Physical sensor latency and robot collision response were outside this trial.
